# Copy review sheet

<!-- Generated by `npm run copy:export` from client/src/lib/sectionCopy.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every page, section, button, and dialog heading in the app. Edit the wording in
`app/client/src/lib/sectionCopy.ts`, then run `npm run copy:export` to refresh this sheet.
`{name}` marks a value filled in at run time. "Technical detail" is shown only in a tooltip.

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | If the code can’t change |

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Upkeep after converting |
| Subtitle | Recommended upkeep for tables that are now managed. Nothing here runs on its own. |

### `compatEvidence`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Find the tables |
| Subtitle | Tables that tools outside Databricks read. They convert either way. |
| Tooltip | Expand a row for the exact statement. Confidence is a guess unless the scan saw a path read. |

### `compatOpenApis`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Step 1 · Open APIs (preferred) |
| Subtitle | Outside tools read the one managed copy through Unity Catalog. There is no second copy. |
| Tooltip | Delta clients use Unity REST, and Iceberg clients use Iceberg REST. An admin turns on external data access and grants EXTERNAL USE SCHEMA. |

### `compatBeforeConvert`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Before the convert |
| Subtitle | Tell each reader team before the window. Path-based reads stop at the convert. |
| Tooltip | Readers that already use the UC open APIs keep working. Record the decision here after the convert. |

### `compatFgac`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Row filters or column masks |
| Subtitle | Compatibility Mode and credential vending cannot serve these tables. Their external readers stop at the convert. |
| Tooltip | After the convert, turn on catalog commits on Databricks Runtime 18.0 or above. Then set up cross-engine ABAC for the readers. |

### `compatEnable`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Step 2 · Compatibility Mode |
| Subtitle | Only for readers that cannot use the open APIs. Give each table an empty storage location. |
| Tooltip | It writes a second, read-only copy after the convert. The app never picks a location, and a blank row stays manual. |

### `compatEnableSingle`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Step 2 · Compatibility Mode |
| Subtitle | Only for a reader that cannot use the open APIs. Give the table an empty storage location. |
| Tooltip | It writes a second, read-only copy after the convert. The app never picks a location. |

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |

### `ownershipEvidence`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Tables not yet authorized |
| Subtitle | {grant} need someone else’s grant and {unchecked} are not checked yet. Authorize can grant {self}. |
| Tooltip | Converting needs ownership or MANAGE on the table, its schema or its catalog. It also needs SELECT and MODIFY unless it owns the table. |
| Technical detail | Read from the stored convert_authority checks (migration/authority.py). Authorize (job_03d) grants only what the convert identity can grant itself; cleanup (job_07) revokes only what it added. |

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Step 1 · Control tables |
| Subtitle | Read access, plus one write to the action list. |
| Technical detail | Least-privilege reads plus the single migration_actions write. |

### `grantsTier2`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Step 2 · Schemas |
| Subtitle | Schema grants that cover every table in each schema, grouped by catalog. |
| Tooltip | Missing only hides the grants already in place. Copy and Download take every grant in the current view, not only the open groups. |
| Technical detail | USE CATALOG is listed once per catalog. Each catalog and schema is checked once with SHOW GRANTS, and the result is reused for up to a minute. Refresh checks again. |

## Primers

### `workstreams`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | What are workstreams? |
| Collapsed prompt | New to workstreams? Read this first. |
| Body | Each workstream is one kind of problem that can stop a table from converting. Open one to see its tables and the steps that fix them. The last one, Maintenance, is upkeep for after the convert. Nothing here converts a table. |

### `workstreamDetail`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | What am I looking at? |
| Collapsed prompt | New to this page? Read this first. |
| Body | Here are the tables with one kind of problem, and why each was flagged. Below are the steps that fix them. You can edit the assignee and notes, and nothing here converts a table. |

### `waves`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | What are waves? |
| Collapsed prompt | New to waves? Read this first. |
| Body | A wave is a group of tables that convert together, sized to stay safe. Open a wave to see its tables and convert it. Each convert lists the exact tables it changes. You can undo it for 14 days. |

### `convertGate`

| Field | Text |
| --- | --- |
| Title | This is where tables convert |
| Collapsed prompt | New to this step? Read this first. |
| Body | Below are the safety checks, the tables that will change, and what keeps running. Type the scope to confirm. The job checks everything again before it changes a table. You can undo it for 14 days. |
